SELECT APAPKIHONCD , APAPNMRYAKUSHO , APSHOPCD , APSHOPNMRYAKUSHO , APSKYSAKICD , APSKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO , APTOKUISAKICD , APTOKUISAKINMN1 , APTOKUISAKIJOTAI , APTOKUISAKIJOTAINM , APJOTAISTS , APJOTAISTSNM , NASKYSAKICD , NASKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO , NATOKUISAKICD , NATOKUISAKINMN1 , NATOKUISAKIJOTAI , NATOKUISAKIJOTAINM , NAJOTAISTS , NAJOTAISTSNM , YUKOKBN FROM (
SELECT AP_MST.APKIHONCD AS APAPKIHONCD , AP_MST.APNMRYAKUSHO AS APAPNMRYAKUSHO , SP_MST.SHOPCD AS APSHOPCD , SP_MST.SHOPNMRYAKUSHO AS APSHOPNMRYAKUSHO , SK_MST.SKYSAKICD AS APSKYSAKICD , SK_MST.SKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO AS APSKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO , TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD AS APTOKUISAKICD , TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN1 AS APTOKUISAKINMN1 , TK_MST.TOKUISAKIJOTAI AS APTOKUISAKIJOTAI , SYKM1.MOJISETTEIATAI AS APTOKUISAKIJOTAINM , TK_MST.JOTAISTS AS APJOTAISTS , SYKM2.MOJISETTEIATAI AS APJOTAISTSNM , TKMST.SKYSAKICD AS NASKYSAKICD , TKMST.SKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO AS NASKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO , TKMST.TOKUISAKICD AS NATOKUISAKICD , TKMST.TOKUISAKINMN1 AS NATOKUISAKINMN1 , TKMST.TOKUISAKIJOTAI AS NATOKUISAKIJOTAI , SYKM3.MOJISETTEIATAI AS NATOKUISAKIJOTAINM , TKMST.JOTAISTS AS NAJOTAISTS , SYKM4.MOJISETTEIATAI AS NAJOTAISTSNM , NA_MST.YUKOKBN FROM S02M057T NA_MST INNER JOIN S02M013T TK_MST -- 得意先マスタ ON ( NA_MST.APAPKIHONCD = TK_MST.APKIHONCD AND NA_MST.APSHOPCD = TK_MST.SHOPCD AND NA_MST.APTOKUISAKICD = TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD LIKE #{aptokuisakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND (TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN1 LIKE '%' || #{aptokuisakinm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN2 LIKE '%' || #{aptokuisakinm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD2 LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD3 LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
) INNER JOIN S02M017T SK_MST -- 請求先マスタ ON ( NA_MST.APAPKIHONCD = SK_MST.APKIHONCD AND NA_MST.APSHOPCD = SK_MST.SHOPCD AND NA_MST.APSKYSAKICD = SK_MST.SKYSAKICD
AND SK_MST.SKYSAKICD LIKE #{apskysakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND (SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN1 LIKE '%' || #{apskysakinmn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN2 LIKE '%' || #{apskysakinmn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
) INNER JOIN S02M046T SP_MST -- ショップマスタ ON ( NA_MST.APAPKIHONCD = SP_MST.APKIHONCD AND NA_MST.APSHOPCD = SP_MST.SHOPCD
AND SP_MST.SHOPCD LIKE #{apshopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND ( SP_MST.SHOPNM LIKE '%' || #{apshopnm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR SP_MST.SHOPNMRYAKUSHO LIKE '%' || #{apshopnm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
) INNER JOIN S02M001T AP_MST -- ＡＰ基本マスタ ON (NA_MST.APAPKIHONCD = AP_MST.APKIHONCD)
AND AP_MST.APKIHONCD LIKE #{apapkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND ( AP_MST.APNM LIKE '%' || #{apapnm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR AP_MST.APNMRYAKUSHO LIKE '%' || #{apapnm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
INNER JOIN ( SELECT TK_MST.APKIHONCD , TK_MST.SHOPCD , TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD , TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN1 , TK_MST.TOKUISAKIJOTAI , TK_MST.JOTAISTS , SK_MST.SKYSAKICD , SK_MST.SKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO FROM S02M013T TK_MST INNER JOIN S02M017T SK_MST ON ( TK_MST.APKIHONCD = SK_MST.APKIHONCD AND TK_MST.SHOPCD = SK_MST.SHOPCD AND TK_MST.SKYSAKICD = SK_MST.SKYSAKICD
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD LIKE #{natokuisakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND (TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN1 LIKE '%' || #{natokuisakinm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN2 LIKE '%' || #{natokuisakinm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD2 LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD3 LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
#{tokuisakijotai}
#{jotaists}
AND SK_MST.SKYSAKICD LIKE #{naskysakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND (SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN1 LIKE '%' || #{naskysakinmn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN2 LIKE '%' || #{naskysakinmn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
) ) TKMST -- 得意先マスタ ON ( NA_MST.ACIAPKIHONCD = TKMST.APKIHONCD AND NA_MST.ACISHOPCD = TKMST.SHOPCD AND NA_MST.ACITOKUISAKICD = TKMST.TOKUISAKICD ) INNER JOIN -- ショップマスタ S02M046T SP_MST_ACI ON ( NA_MST.ACIAPKIHONCD = SP_MST_ACI.APKIHONCD AND NA_MST.ACISHOPCD = SP_MST_ACI.SHOPCD ) INNER JOIN -- ＡＰ基本マスタ S02M001T AP_MST_ACI ON (NA_MST.ACIAPKIHONCD = AP_MST_ACI.APKIHONCD) LEFT JOIN S02M006T SYKM1 ON ( SYKM1.APKIHONCD = '000' AND SYKM1.SHOPCD = '000' AND SYKM1.SETTEINO = '014' AND SYKM1.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND SYKM1.SETTEICD = TK_MST.TOKUISAKIJOTAI ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T SYKM2 ON ( SYKM2.APKIHONCD = '000' AND SYKM2.SHOPCD = '000' AND SYKM2.SETTEINO = '015' AND SYKM2.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND SYKM2.SETTEICD = TK_MST.JOTAISTS ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T SYKM3 ON ( SYKM3.APKIHONCD = '000' AND SYKM3.SHOPCD = '000' AND SYKM3.SETTEINO = '014' AND SYKM3.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND SYKM3.SETTEICD = TKMST.TOKUISAKIJOTAI ) LEFT JOIN S02M006T SYKM4 ON ( SYKM4.APKIHONCD = '000' AND SYKM4.SHOPCD = '000' AND SYKM4.SETTEINO = '015' AND SYKM4.RCRDKBN = 'M' AND SYKM4.SETTEICD = TKMST.JOTAISTS ) WHERE NA_MST.ACIAPKIHONCD = #{apkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NA_MST.ACISHOPCD = #{shopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND NA_MST.YUKOKBN = '1'
AND NA_MST.YUKOKBN = '0'
AND 1 = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT AP_MST.APKIHONCD AS APAPKIHONCD , AP_MST.APNMRYAKUSHO AS APAPNMRYAKUSHO , SP_MST.SHOPCD AS APSHOPCD , SP_MST.SHOPNMRYAKUSHO AS APSHOPNMRYAKUSHO , SKMST.SKYSAKICD AS APSKYSAKICD , SKMST.SKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO AS APSKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO , TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD AS APTOKUISAKICD , TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN1 AS APTOKUISAKINMN1 , TK_MST.TOKUISAKIJOTAI AS APTOKUISAKIJOTAI , SYKM1.MOJISETTEIATAI AS APTOKUISAKIJOTAINM , TK_MST.JOTAISTS AS APJOTAISTS , SYKM2.MOJISETTEIATAI AS APJOTAISTSNM , '' AS NASKYSAKICD , '' AS NASKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO , '' AS NATOKUISAKICD , '' AS NATOKUISAKINMN1 , '' AS NATOKUISAKIJOTAI , '' AS NATOKUISAKIJOTAINM , '' AS NAJOTAISTS , '' AS NAJOTAISTSNM , '' AS YUKOKBN FROM ( SELECT SK_MST.APKIHONCD , SK_MST.SHOPCD , SK_MST.SKYSAKICD , SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN1 , SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN2 , SK_MST.SKYSAKINMRYAKUSHO FROM S02M017T SK_MST WHERE SK_MST.ACIKEIYUFLG = '1'
AND SK_MST.SKYSAKICD LIKE #{apskysakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND (SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN1 LIKE '%' || #{apskysakinmn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR SK_MST.SKYSAKINMN2 LIKE '%' || #{apskysakinmn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
) SKMST -- 請求先マスタ INNER JOIN S02M013T TK_MST -- 得意先マスタ ON ( SKMST.APKIHONCD = TK_MST.APKIHONCD AND SKMST.SHOPCD = TK_MST.SHOPCD AND SKMST.SKYSAKICD = TK_MST.SKYSAKICD AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM S02M057T NA_MST WHERE NA_MST.APAPKIHONCD = TK_MST.APKIHONCD AND NA_MST.APSHOPCD = TK_MST.SHOPCD AND NA_MST.APTOKUISAKICD = TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD )
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKICD LIKE #{aptokuisakicd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND (TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN1 LIKE '%' || #{aptokuisakinm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR TK_MST.TOKUISAKINMN2 LIKE '%' || #{aptokuisakinm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD2 LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
AND TK_MST.TOKUISAKIGAIBUSKBTSCD3 LIKE #{gaibuskbtscd1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}||'%'
) INNER JOIN S02M046T SP_MST -- ショップマスタ ON SKMST.APKIHONCD = SP_MST.APKIHONCD AND SKMST.SHOPCD = SP_MST.SHOPCD
AND SP_MST.SHOPCD LIKE #{apshopcd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND ( SP_MST.SHOPNM LIKE '%' || #{apshopnm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR SP_MST.SHOPNMRYAKUSHO LIKE '%' || #{apshopnm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
INNER JOIN S02M001T AP_MST ON (SKMST.APKIHONCD = AP_MST.APKIHONCD)
AND AP_MST.APKIHONCD LIKE #{apapkihoncd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
